name: 18_explicit_vs_implicit_vr
title: Explicit vs Implicit VR transfer syntax
description: A is Explicit VR Little Endian, B is Implicit VR Little Endian. Every value is the same, but implicit VR cannot carry the VR of private tags, so they read back as UN.
symptom: After a forward through a gateway that re-encodes to Implicit VR, private tags lose their VRs (become UN) and vendor applications can no longer interpret them.
